_meta.what: Which stage is live at each daytime hour (+ optional draw 1-5). The organiser owns this. Crowd flows ONLY to live stages -> it migrates across the site through the day. REQUIRED input: no program = no run, NO assumed fallback rotation.
_meta.tier: ASSUMED (ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO) — this is a placeholder organiser program for the Parc del Forum demo so the pipeline runs end-to-end. It is NOT scraped real Primavera daytime set-times. For a real run the organiser inputs their own program; the OPTIONAL demo refinement is to scrape Clashfinder ps26 / official lineup DAYTIME rows (follow-up).
_meta.owner: the festival organiser (per site). Demo values authored 2026-06-22 by CD-A Phase 3.
_meta.stage_names_match: geojson stage names in viz/data/festival_map_2026.geojson (same convention as set_times_2026.json night rows).
_meta.draw_scale: 1-5 ordinal pull (5 = strongest daytime draw). Optional; default 1.0 when omitted. REFINES demand, does not gate.
_meta.active_means: stage exerts crowd pull during its active_hours; outside them its pull drops to a low baseline (the modelling formula gates pull on active; see phase-3/decisions.md CON-003).
_meta.window: daytime hours only (gates-open..pre-night). Night headliners live in set_times_2026.json, untouched.

draw_provenance.source: Spotify monthly listeners per headliner (artist pages / chartmasters), captured 2026-06-21..23
draw_provenance.method: per-set weight = log10-scaled monthly listeners -> 1..5; per-stage draw = headline (max-listener) act on the stage, same mapping
draw_provenance.note: Replaces the ASSUMED 1-5 hand table. Popularity DRIVER now GROUNDED; the per-zone spawn split (85/15) stays ASSUMED. Night lineup used as the stage brand-pull proxy for the daytime sim (the daytime lineup itself is illustrative).
